_why: NOCHE50 (OWNER 2026-11-19): every milestone has one measurable metric, a file allowlist and a time cap; tools/audit_rails.py checks the mechanics, a blind bec auditor judges the diff. Telemetry: build/webcheck-<port>.telemetry.ndjson, copied to out/<slice>/before.ndjson and after.ndjson; numbers from tools/gate50_referee.py.

g50-save.pass: before has >= 5 save_over33 frames (the window exercised saves) and after <= 1
g50-save.guard: load-menu thumbnail screenshot out/g50-save/loadmenu.png shows the saved scene; everything committed

g50-bt.guard: bt_share_pct after >= 0.7 x before (bullet time still used and still slows the world)

g50-load.guard: load_seconds after <= 1.15 x before; textures correct in the first game shot (out/g50-load/after.png)

live-web.pass: build/public exists with gzip pieces <= 0.70 x raw bytes (census/compression.tsv: gzip reaches 0.655 of 2156 MB at best), WebGL 2 reaches the main menu (screenshot), WebGPU still reaches the menu (screenshot)
live-web.guard: no game data in git; nothing leaves the Mac

g50-load2.pass: after load_over33 <= 0.5 x before (before = current main, ~91 in this window) and load_over250 == 0
g50-load2.guard: load_seconds after <= 1.15 x before; textures correct in the first game shot

g50-comic.guard: comic panels render complete and sharp (screenshot out/g50-comic/after.png vs before.png)

g50-game.pass: after <= 0.5 x before, with the 3 costliest guest functions in slow frames named with addresses
g50-game.guard: difftest passes on every function touched (RN_FUNCS)

live-web2.repro: RN_RTT_MS=80 python3 tools/static_server.py build/public 5254 & node tools/loadcap.mjs http://127.0.0.1:5254/
live-web2.metric: seconds from navigation to main menu at 80 ms RTT, cold cache
live-web2.pass: after <= 0.7 x before (prefetch of the first level's pieces, like RE-NFSU entry_hint)
live-web2.guard: warm load not slower; WebGPU and WebGL 2 still reach the menu

g50-comic2.metric: comic frames > 33.4 ms (referee causes starting with 'comic:')
g50-comic2.pass: after == 0 and the decode function's ms per page measured before -> after
g50-comic2.guard: comic page pixels identical to the guest decoder (difftest or a byte compare of the decoded buffer, RN_DUMPCALL vs djpeg if JPEG)
